name: Shared Wealth
text: Each player who has units adjacent to this planet may draw 1 action card. Gain 1 trade good for each player who does.
flavorText: *The colony threw its granaries open to every passing crew. Gratitude, the governor reasoned, was the cheapest currency in the galaxy.*
notes: The exploring player may also draw, and gains 1 trade good for their own draw as well.
automationNotes: Each player with units in or next to the system gets a draw button; the explorer gains 1 trade good per draw.

name: Tourism Bureau
text: Gain 1 commodity for each wormhole, anomaly and legendary planet adjacent to this planet.
flavorText: *Guided tours of the rift's edge sold out within the hour. Nobody asked what had happened to the last group.*
automationNotes: Counts wormholes, anomalies and other legendary planets in and next to the system and gives that many commodities.

name: Direct Import
text: Gain 1 commodity. Then, you may move 1 of your ships from an adjacent system into this system.
flavorText: *The freighter arrived with its manifest in perfect order, and its escort exactly where the buyer wanted it.*
automationNotes: Gives 1 commodity, then offers to move 1 of your ships from an adjacent system.

name: Initial Investment Surplus
text: You may spend 1 commodity or 1 trade good to ready this planet.
flavorText: *The colonial charter had been overfunded by a clerical error. The administrators saw no reason to report it.*
automationNotes: Spend-a-commodity or spend-a-trade-good buttons ready the planet.

name: Cross-species Mingling
text: Place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on this planet, plus 1 additional infantry for each planet in or adjacent to this system that contains another player's infantry.
flavorText: *Within a generation the settlers of three species shared one market, one dialect and, increasingly, one militia.*
automationNotes: Places the infantry automatically.

name: Emergency Abort Signal
text: Attach: When this planet's controller announces a retreat, if this system is within 3 systems of the active system, they may retreat into this system. If they do, they may repair 1 of their damaged units after the retreat.
flavorText: *The beacon screamed on every emergency band at once, a bright thread leading home through the dark.*
automationNotes: Retreat targeting and repair are not automated; resolve them yourselves.

name: Imperialistic Gates
text: Attach: After this planet's controller activates the Mecatol Rex system, they purge this card. Then, ships that begin their movement in this planet's system are treated as if they were adjacent to Mecatol Rex.
flavorText: *The old imperial transit arches still answered to the right codes. Once.*
automationNotes: Movement is not calculated by the bot; purge the attachment and move yourselves.

name: Local Tariffs
text: Attach: After a player activates a system, you may allow that player to move ships through this planet's system as if it contained no ships. If they do, you may take 1 trade good from that player and gain 1 commodity.
flavorText: *Safe passage, the customs officer explained, was guaranteed. The receipt cost extra.*
automationNotes: Movement through ships and the trade good payment are not automated.

name: Faux Altruistic Festivals
text: Each of your neighbors may give you 1 promissory note from their hand; each neighbor who does draws 1 action card. Then, draw 1 action card.
flavorText: *The banners promised friendship between all peoples. The guest list had been drawn up with rather more calculation.*
automationNotes: You draw 1 action card; each neighbor gets give-a-promissory-note buttons and draws 1 action card if they give one.

name: Distraction Efforts
text: Gain 3 trade goods. Then, you may perform 1 additional component action.
flavorText: *A few forged beacons and one burning decoy hulk, and every patrol in the sector was looking the wrong way.*
automationNotes: Gives 3 trade goods and an extra component action button.

name: Wasteful Pirates
text: Roll 5 dice. For each result of 6 or greater, assign 1 hit to your ships in this system. Gain 1 trade good for each hit you assign.
flavorText: *The raiders fired wildly, looted half of what they hit, and dumped the rest to make room for more.*
automationNotes: Rolls 5 dice, offers the assign-hits button for your ships here and gives 1 trade good per hit your ships can take.

name: Rich Hostages
text: Place this card face up in your play area. When you score a 1-point objective that requires you to spend trade goods, influence, resources or command tokens, you may purge this card to reduce that cost by 3.
flavorText: *The ransom note arrived with a portrait of the heir and a very reasonable payment schedule.*
automationNotes: Goes to your play area. When you score a 1-point public objective that requires spending, you get a purge button; adjust the spending yourself (if the bot deducted the 5 trade goods for Negotiate Trade Routes, it refunds 3). The bot's score check does not know the discount.

name: Subjectivity Equation
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 3 trade goods, or you may purge this card and spend 5 resources to research 1 blue technology.
flavorText: *Once the navigators accepted that distance was a matter of opinion, the drives began to agree with them.*
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 3 trade goods, or purge it and spend 5 resources to research a blue technology.

name: Destructive Elements
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 3 trade goods, or you may purge this card and spend 5 resources to research 1 red technology.
flavorText: *The isotopes were unstable, illegal in eleven systems, and exactly what the weapons division had asked for.*
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 3 trade goods, or purge it and spend 5 resources to research a red technology.

name: Ancient Biological Specimens
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 3 trade goods, or you may purge this card and spend 5 resources to research 1 green technology.
flavorText: *Sealed in glass for a hundred thousand years, the samples stirred the moment the laboratory lights came on.*
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 3 trade goods, or purge it and spend 5 resources to research a green technology.

name: Hyper Algorithms
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 3 trade goods, or you may purge this card and spend 5 resources to research 1 yellow technology.
flavorText: *The code rewrote itself overnight. By morning it was solving problems no one had thought to ask.*
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 3 trade goods, or purge it and spend 5 resources to research a yellow technology.

name: Faulty Emergency Signal
text: If no other player has ships in your home system, you may move any number of your ships from the active system to your home system.
flavorText: *The recall order was a malfunction. By the time anyone noticed, half the fleet was already home.*
automationNotes: Move-ship-home buttons, offered only if no other player's ships are in your home system.

name: Insatiable Fuel Source
text: Each player who has a command token in this system returns it to their tactic pool.
flavorText: *A single tank of the stuff could refuel a battle group, and every fleet waiting on resupply was suddenly free to move.*
automationNotes: Every command token in the system returns to its owner's tactic pool.

name: Replication Arrays
text: Discard 2 action cards, if able. Then, take 1 action card of your choice from the action card discard pile and add it to your hand.
flavorText: *Feed the array two blueprints and it hands back a third, usually one you had already thrown away.*
automationNotes: Discard buttons for 2 action cards, then the pick-from-discard buttons.

name: Interesting Contagion
text: Place 1 frontier token in each adjacent system that contains no planets and no frontier token.
flavorText: *Whatever the probes brought back was spreading, quietly, from one empty patch of space to the next.*
automationNotes: Places frontier tokens in adjacent empty systems without one.

name: Emergent Defenses
text: If you have at least 1 mech on this planet, or if you remove 1 infantry from this planet, place 1 PDS from your reinforcements on this planet.
flavorText: *Buried beneath the ice lay a defense battery, its targeting arrays still tracking ships that had left millennia ago.*
automationNotes: Use-a-mech or remove-1-infantry buttons, then places the PDS.

name: Pilot Recovery Program
text: If you have at least 1 mech on this planet, or if you remove 1 infantry from this planet, gain 1 command token and place it in your fleet pool.
flavorText: *The search teams pulled the downed pilots from the wreckage alive. Every one of them asked for a new ship.*
automationNotes: Use-a-mech or remove-1-infantry buttons, then adds 1 fleet token.

name: Pilot Recovery Program
text: If you have at least 1 mech on this planet, or if you remove 1 infantry from this planet, gain 1 command token and place it in your fleet pool.
flavorText: *The rescue beacon still blinked after three weeks. So did the pilot, stubbornly, at the bottom of the crater.*
automationNotes: Use-a-mech or remove-1-infantry buttons, then adds 1 fleet token.

name: Lost and Found
text: If you have at least 1 mech on this planet, or if you remove 1 infantry from this planet, place 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in this system's space area if it contains no other player's ships.
flavorText: *The derelict's crew had been gone for centuries, but its engines warmed at the first touch.*
automationNotes: Use-a-mech or remove-1-infantry buttons, then places the destroyer if no other player's ships are there.

name: Lost and Found
text: If you have at least 1 mech on this planet, or if you remove 1 infantry from this planet, place 1 destroyer from your reinforcements in this system's space area if it contains no other player's ships.
flavorText: *Its registry read "lost with all hands, Lazax year 4,105". It had been waiting in the dust ever since.*
automationNotes: Use-a-mech or remove-1-infantry buttons, then places the destroyer if no other player's ships are there.

name: Imitation Factories
text: Choose 1 card in the hazardous exploration discard pile and resolve it as if you had just explored this planet. Then, purge this card.
flavorText: *The factories copied everything they found, down to the last flaw, and sometimes the danger along with it.*
automationNotes: Pick a card from the hazardous discard pile; it resolves on this planet and Imitation Factories is purged. The copied card is automated as far as its own line says.

name: Imitation Factories
text: Choose 1 card in the hazardous exploration discard pile and resolve it as if you had just explored this planet. Then, purge this card.
flavorText: *The Hylar engineers studied the ruins for a week. Then the ruins began studying them back.*
automationNotes: Pick a card from the hazardous discard pile; it resolves on this planet and Imitation Factories is purged. The copied card is automated as far as its own line says.

name: Imitation Factories
text: Choose 1 card in the hazardous exploration discard pile and resolve it as if you had just explored this planet. Then, purge this card.
flavorText: *Nobody remembered who first switched the assembly lines on. Nobody could find the switch to turn them off.*
automationNotes: Pick a card from the hazardous discard pile; it resolves on this planet and Imitation Factories is purged. The copied card is automated as far as its own line says.

name: Imitation Factories
text: Choose 1 card in the hazardous exploration discard pile and resolve it as if you had just explored this planet. Then, purge this card.
flavorText: *Each copy was perfect, right down to the warning labels nobody could read.*
automationNotes: Pick a card from the hazardous discard pile; it resolves on this planet and Imitation Factories is purged. The copied card is automated as far as its own line says.

name: Corrosive Discovery
text: Roll 3 dice. Gain 1 trade good for each result of 5 or greater. For each result of 2 or less, assign 1 hit to your ground forces on this planet.
flavorText: *The ore was priceless and the air was acid. The prospectors were paid by the kilogram, not by the hour.*
automationNotes: Rolls 3 dice, gives the trade goods and offers the assign-hits button. The button lists ground forces on every planet in the system; assign to this planet.

name: Corrosive Discovery
text: Roll 3 dice. Gain 1 trade good for each result of 5 or greater. For each result of 2 or less, assign 1 hit to your ground forces on this planet.
flavorText: *The drill bits dissolved in an hour. The crystals they reached were worth a fleet.*
automationNotes: Rolls 3 dice, gives the trade goods and offers the assign-hits button. The button lists ground forces on every planet in the system; assign to this planet.

name: Precision Laser Defenses
text: Attach: While this planet's system is the active system, this planet has SPACE CANNON 3.
flavorText: *The beam lattice tracks everything that enters the system and burns it long before it can choose a landing site.*
automationNotes: The planet gets Space Cannon 3 from the attachment data; it fires only in its own system.

name: Inhospitable Environment
text: Attach: Each time infantry are committed to or produced on this planet, roll 1 die for each of those infantry. For each result of 3 or less, destroy 1 of those infantry.
flavorText: *The air burns, the ground shifts, and the native spores have strong opinions about visitors.*
automationNotes: Infantry landed with the land buttons or produced on the planet gets a roll button. Other ways of committing infantry are not detected.

name: Electromagnetic Flux
text: Attach: During ground combat on this planet, mechs that do not belong to this planet's controller lose their unit abilities and SUSTAIN DAMAGE.
flavorText: *Every servo seizes and every shield stutters. The planet's own garrison learned long ago to fight by hand.*
automationNotes: Mech abilities in ground combat are not switched off by the bot.

name: Defensive Bastion
text: Attach: When your ships retreat into this system, if it does not contain 1 of your command tokens, you may place up to 4 fighters from your reinforcements in its space area.
flavorText: *The bastion's hangars stood fuelled and waiting for the day a battered fleet would limp home.*
automationNotes: Retreating with the bot's retreat buttons into this system without your command token offers to place up to 4 fighters.

name: Repurposed Facilities
text: You may spend 5 resources to place 1 space dock from your reinforcements on this planet. If you do not, gain 1 trade good.
flavorText: *The derelict refinery needed only power, a crew and a great deal of welding to build ships again.*
automationNotes: Space dock plus resource payment buttons, or 1 trade good.

name: Ancient Excavators
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 1 trade good, or you may purge this card and spend 2 resources to gain the Scanlink Drone Network technology. This card can be traded as part of a transaction.
flavorText: *The excavators had dug on alone for millennia, mapping every tunnel and waiting for someone to read the results.*
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 1 trade good, or purge it and spend 2 resources to gain Scanlink Drone Network. Can be traded as a relic in transactions.

name: Daunting Weapons Schematics
text: Place this card face up in your play area. At the start of your turn, you may purge this card to gain 1 trade good, or you may purge this card and spend 5 resources to gain the Dreadnought II unit upgrade technology. This card can be traded as part of a transaction.
flavorText: *The blueprints called for a hull so heavy that the shipwrights laughed, and then asked about the budget.*
automationNotes: Goes to your play area with a start-of-turn button: purge it for 1 trade good, or purge it and spend 5 resources to gain Dreadnought II. Can be traded as a relic in transactions.

name: Enhanced Mobility Core
text: Place this card face up in your play area. If you have Gravity Drive, it gives 2 additional movement instead of 1. This card can be traded as part of a transaction.
flavorText: *The core hums at a pitch that sets teeth on edge, and folds distance like paper.*
automationNotes: Goes to your play area and can be traded; the extra movement is not calculated.

name: Military Procedural Documents
text: If there are no mechs on this planet, you may replace 1 of your infantry on this planet with 1 mech from your reinforcements. Otherwise, gain 1 commodity.
flavorText: *Page four hundred described, in tedious detail, how to build a war machine from spare parts and one volunteer.*
automationNotes: Replace-infantry-with-mech button when the planet has no mech; otherwise 1 commodity.

name: Military Procedural Documents
text: If there are no mechs on this planet, you may replace 1 of your infantry on this planet with 1 mech from your reinforcements. Otherwise, gain 1 commodity.
flavorText: *The manual was signed by a Sardakk N'orr quartermaster and stamped "field-tested". Nobody asked on whom.*
automationNotes: Replace-infantry-with-mech button when the planet has no mech; otherwise 1 commodity.

name: Profitable Factories
text: Attach: When this planet is exhausted, gain 1 trade good and exhaust this card.
flavorText: *The assembly lines never stopped. Even when the planet went quiet, the ledgers kept running.*
automationNotes: Exhausting the planet with spend or vote buttons gives 1 trade good, once until this card is readied again. Exhausting it some other way does not trigger it.

name: Carbon Consciousness
text: Attach: When this planet is exhausted, you may spend influence equal to its resource value to ready it. If you do, place 1 infantry from your reinforcements on this planet.
flavorText: *The colony's bioreactors turn civic devotion into fuel, and fuel into fresh recruits.*
automationNotes: Exhausting the planet with spend or vote buttons offers to ready it and place 1 infantry, with influence payment buttons. The bot offers it once per turn for each planet.

name: Efficiency Techniques
text: Attach: If any unit on this planet has PRODUCTION, increase this planet's PRODUCTION value by 2.
flavorText: *Retooled lines, rotating shifts and an overseer who never sleeps.*
automationNotes: Adds 2 to the planet's production when units on it have production.

name: Affordable Mass Production
text: Attach: When fighters are produced using the PRODUCTION of units in this system, reduce the combined cost of the produced units by 1.
flavorText: *Stamped from scrap, fuelled by optimism, and delivered by the dozen.*
automationNotes: Production cost drops by 1 when fighters are produced in this system.

name: Foresight of Industry
text: You may gain 2 commodities, or you may spend 1 influence to reveal the top card of the industrial exploration deck and resolve it on this planet.
flavorText: *The surveyors' projections were so precise that the next discovery was already pencilled into the budget.*
automationNotes: Gain 2 commodities, or spend 1 influence to resolve the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Foresight of Industry
text: You may gain 2 commodities, or you may spend 1 influence to reveal the top card of the industrial exploration deck and resolve it on this planet.
flavorText: *The Hacan trade guild had already sold shares in the mine before the first shaft was dug.*
automationNotes: Gain 2 commodities, or spend 1 influence to resolve the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Foresight of Industry
text: You may gain 2 commodities, or you may spend 1 influence to reveal the top card of the industrial exploration deck and resolve it on this planet.
flavorText: *Old Lazax survey markers still pointed the way to seams nobody had bothered to mine.*
automationNotes: Gain 2 commodities, or spend 1 influence to resolve the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Foresight of Industry
text: You may gain 2 commodities, or you may spend 1 influence to reveal the top card of the industrial exploration deck and resolve it on this planet.
flavorText: *The forecast was wrong only once, and the analyst responsible was promoted for his boldness.*
automationNotes: Gain 2 commodities, or spend 1 influence to resolve the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Established Surveying
text: You may gain 1 commodity for each attachment on other planets in or adjacent to this system. If there are none, reveal the top card of the industrial exploration deck and resolve it on this planet.
flavorText: *Every outpost in range was quietly feeding its survey data into the same industrial forecast.*
automationNotes: Counts attachments on other planets in or next to this system; with none, resolves the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Established Surveying
text: You may gain 1 commodity for each attachment on other planets in or adjacent to this system. If there are none, reveal the top card of the industrial exploration deck and resolve it on this planet.
flavorText: *Each new attachment on the neighbouring worlds sent another column of numbers to the regional planners.*
automationNotes: Counts attachments on other planets in or next to this system; with none, resolves the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Established Surveying
text: You may gain 1 commodity for each attachment on other planets in or adjacent to this system. If there are none, reveal the top card of the industrial exploration deck and resolve it on this planet.
flavorText: *The planners called it synergy. The miners called it more paperwork.*
automationNotes: Counts attachments on other planets in or next to this system; with none, resolves the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Established Surveying
text: You may gain 1 commodity for each attachment on other planets in or adjacent to this system. If there are none, reveal the top card of the industrial exploration deck and resolve it on this planet.
flavorText: *Where three settlements traded, a fourth was always already being drawn on the map.*
automationNotes: Counts attachments on other planets in or next to this system; with none, resolves the next industrial exploration card here.

name: Data Interchange Hub
text: Attach: During its controller's turn, this planet's controller may transact with any player who has ships in a system that contains a wormhole.
flavorText: *Every signal through the wormhole passes through the hub first, and the hub's owners listen to all of them.*
automationNotes: The transaction permission is not given by the bot.

name: It's a Trap!
text: Of the players whose home systems are more than 5 hexes from this system, the one with the fewest victory points may place up to 4 destroyers in this system; if tied, choose 1 at random. That player immediately engages in space combat with the other players who have ships in this system.
flavorText: *The frontier beacon was bait, and the ambushers had been waiting a very long time for someone to take it.*
notes: Distance counts adjacency, so wormholes and hyperlanes count as adjacent. The exploring player can be the chosen player. If no player's home system is far enough away, nothing happens.
automationNotes: Picks the player with the fewest victory points among those whose home is more than 5 hexes away (random tie-break); they place up to 4 destroyers and combat starts.

name: Systematic Sympathies
text: Destroy all units in this system. Each player whose destroyed ships have a combined cost of 4 or more gains 1 victory point. Each other player who lost units gains 1 trade good.
flavorText: *The resonance tore every hull in the system apart, and the galaxy remembered those who lost the most.*
notes: Use each ship's production cost; each fighter counts as 0.5. The victory point is permanent and is scored as a custom objective named Systematic Sympathies (a player's second one is Systematic Sympathies 2, and so on). Every player who lost units here without gaining the victory point gains 1 trade good.
automationNotes: Destroys all units; players who lose ships costing 4 or more score the Systematic Sympathies custom objective (1 point), other players who lost units gain 1 trade good.

name: Pondering the Nebulae
text: You may discard 1 of your unscored secret objectives. If you do, draw 1 secret objective.
flavorText: *Hours spent watching the nebula's slow storms left the admiral with a very different idea of what mattered.*
automationNotes: Discard buttons for your unscored secret objectives in your cards info thread; a new one is drawn.

name: We're Lost, Captain
text: The speaker chooses a system that contains no planets and no other player's ships. Move all of your units in this system's space area to the chosen system, then place 1 command token from your reinforcements in that system, if able.
flavorText: *The navigator swore the charts were correct. The stars, unfortunately, disagreed.*
notes: Only the exploring player's units in the space area move, including fighters and ground forces in space. Other players' units stay where they are.
automationNotes: The speaker picks the system; your space units move there and your command token is placed.

name: MacGuffin Outpost
text: Place this card face up in your play area. When you lose a space combat, you and the winner each gain 2 trade goods.
flavorText: *Nobody knew what the outpost actually guarded, only that every warlord in the sector wanted it.*
automationNotes: Goes to your play area. You and the winner each get 2 trade goods when you lose your last ship to the bot's assign-hits buttons; a neutral winner gains nothing. Retreats and losses outside those buttons are not detected.

name: Unseen Danger
text: Destroy all of your ships in this system and place 1 asteroid field token in this system. If you destroyed at least 1 ship, you may gain Antimass Deflectors if you do not own it.
flavorText: *The asteroid field was invisible to every sensor right up until the first hull breached.*
automationNotes: Destroys your ships here, places an asteroid field token and offers Antimass Deflectors.

name: Foregone Discoveries
text: Reveal the top card of the relic deck and choose a player; that player gains that relic. During this action phase, you and that player may transact even if you are not neighbors.
flavorText: *The relic had been found, lost and found again so often that nobody remembered who it belonged to.*
notes: The chosen player gains exactly the revealed relic.
automationNotes: Shows the top relic; the chosen player gains exactly that relic and may transact with you this action phase.

name: Overcharged Targeting System
text: Attach: Apply +1 to the result of each SPACE CANNON roll made by units on this planet.
flavorText: *Recalibrated firing solutions, overclocked capacitors and a maintenance crew sworn to secrecy.*
automationNotes: Units on this planet get +1 on space cannon rolls.

name: Production Relay
text: Attach: When fighters are produced using the PRODUCTION of units in this system, choose a player. That player places 2 fighters from their reinforcements in their home system if it contains no other player's ships.
flavorText: *Half of every fighter batch is routed through the relay to wherever its owners decide it is needed most.*
automationNotes: After you click Done Producing with fighters made in this system you pick a player for the 2 fighters. Other production paths are not detected.
